name: Rewrite stories with specific setting, tone, or character changes
description: Users asked to rewrite or adapt existing stories, scenes, and dialogue, often by changing the setting to match specific fictional universes, altering character genders or roles, or shifting the narrative tone and style. Many requests also involved adding specific plot details, continuing the story, or providing suggestions for improvement and plot twists.
